---
title: "Team Challenge Scoreboard"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: [default, ../slides/custom.scss]
    slide-number: false
    controls: false
    progress: false
    center: true
    transition: none
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(gt)

# =====================================================================
# Data loaded from CSVs produced by scripts/update-team-points.R
# =====================================================================

scoreboard <- read_csv(here("team_points.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    total = pair_coding + assignments + quizzes + fun_challenge + bonus,
    team_name = fct_reorder(team_name, total)
  )

rankings <- read_csv(here("team_rankings.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

current_week = rankings |> 
  filter(week_points > 0)  |> 
  filter(week == max(week)) |> 
  filter(row_number() == 1) |> 
  pull(week) + 1


# Color: leading team(s) get highlight color, others get gray
max_pts <- max(scoreboard$total)
scoreboard <- scoreboard |>
  mutate(is_leader = total == max_pts & total > 0)

# Shared values for the rankings charts
n_teams <- n_distinct(rankings$team_name)
rankings_filtered <- rankings |> filter(week < current_week)
last_week <- max(rankings_filtered$week)

# Helper: render the standings bar chart at a given reveal stage.
#   1 = bottom 3 only
#   2 = + the next two (4th and 3rd place)
#   3 = + 3rd-place highlight (bronze + label)
#   4 = + the two leaders tied for 1st
x_max <- max(scoreboard$total) * 1.18

chart_stage <- function(stage) {
  d <- scoreboard |>
    mutate(
      visible = case_when(
        stage == 1 ~ total <= 29,
        stage == 2 ~ total <= 41,
        stage == 3 ~ total <= 41,
        stage >= 4 ~ TRUE
      ),
      bar_total = if_else(visible, as.numeric(total), NA_real_),
      bar_label = if_else(visible, as.character(total), ""),
      bar_fill = case_when(
        !visible ~ "hidden",
        stage == 3 & team_name == "R-odents" ~ "third",
        is_leader & stage >= 4 ~ "leader",
        TRUE ~ "other"
      )
    )

  team_levels <- levels(scoreboard$team_name)
  visible_set <- d |> filter(visible) |> pull(team_name) |> as.character()
  y_labels <- if_else(team_levels %in% visible_set, team_levels, "")

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(y = team_name)) +
    geom_col(aes(x = bar_total, fill = bar_fill), width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = bar_total, label = bar_label),
      hjust = -0.3, size = 5, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("leader" = "#e67e22", "other" = "#95a5a6",
                 "third" = "#cd7f32", "hidden" = NA),
      guide = "none",
      na.value = NA
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, x_max), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(x = "Total Points", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
    )

  if (stage == 3) {
    r_row <- scoreboard |> filter(team_name == "R-odents")
    p <- p + annotate(
      "text", x = r_row$total + 4, y = r_row$team_name,
      label = "third place!", color = "#cd7f32",
      fontface = "bold", size = 6, hjust = 0
    )
  }

  p
}
```


## Week `r current_week` Standings

::: {.r-stack}

```{r}
#| label: scoreboard-chart-1
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
chart_stage(1)
```

## Rankings Over Time

```{r}
#| label: rankings-option2-dodge
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-alt: "Bump chart of team ranks over time, with tied teams nudged slightly apart so overlapping lines remain visible."

rankings_dodged <- rankings_filtered |>
  arrange(week, rank, team_name) |>
  group_by(week, rank) |>
  mutate(
    tie_offset = (row_number() - (n() + 1) / 2) * 0.18,
    display_rank = rank + tie_offset
  ) |>
  ungroup()

label_data_dodge <- rankings_dodged |>
  filter(week == last_week)

rankings_dodged |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = display_rank, color = team_name, group = team_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha = .7) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data_dodge,
    aes(label = team_name),
    nudge_x = 0.3,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.color = "gray70",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = seq_len(n_teams),
    labels = \(x) paste0("#", x)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_len(max(rankings$week)),
    labels = \(x) paste0("Wk ", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

## Cumulative Points

```{r}
#| label: rankings-option1-points
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-alt: "Line chart showing cumulative team points over time, with teams spreading apart as the term progresses."

label_data_pts <- rankings_filtered |>
  filter(week == last_week)

rankings_filtered |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = cumulative, color = team_name, group = team_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5, alpha = .7) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data_pts,
    aes(label = team_name),
    nudge_x = 0.3,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.size = 0.3,
    segment.color = "gray70",
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_len(max(rankings$week)),
    labels = \(x) paste0("Wk ", x),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative points") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

## Point Breakdown

```{r}
#| label: scoreboard-table

scoreboard |>
  arrange(desc(total), team_name) |>
  select(
    Team = team_name,
    `Pair Coding` = pair_coding,
    Assignments = assignments,
    Quizzes = quizzes,
    `Fun Challenge` = fun_challenge,
    Bonus = bonus,
    Total = total
  ) |>
  gt() |>
  data_color(
    columns = c(`Pair Coding`, Assignments, Quizzes, `Fun Challenge`, Bonus, Total),
    palette = "Oranges",
    na_color = "white"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -Team) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = Team) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Total)
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(20),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```
